title: Why AI Can't Count Letters (And the Simple Fix)
description:
Last time, some AI models miscounted letters. We gave 2 models the same 20 questions twice: once plainly, once asking them to spell the word out first. Code marked every reply. Spelling out first added 4 right answers across the models. One test, run on 10 November 2026; results change between runs and as models update. Token count measured with Gemini's tokenizer.

#Shorts #AI #AITested #ChatGPT #Gemini

Source for how models read text: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model
